contract: Common Z and E edges may have arbitrary complex first derivatives. Independent nonzero common factors in the lepton and down sectors may have arbitrary complex first derivatives. Physical scalar matching requires a canonical mode, its real projection on phi, a consistently transported vertex, and no other nonuniversal contribution.
